title: Sagrada Família €26. Beijing's Lama Temple ¥25 | China Travel Expert
description:
A Tibetan-Buddhist price check. Barcelona's Sagrada Família charges about €26 for basic basilica entry in 2026. Beijing's Lama Temple (Yonghe Gong / Yonghegong) — the city's most important and active Tibetan Buddhist monastery — charges about ¥25. In US dollars that is roughly 30 dollars versus under 4 dollars: about eight times cheaper.

Both now run on advance, timed-entry booking — Sagrada Família releases slots up to two months out, and the Lama Temple is 100 percent pre-booked (passport plus the official mini-program). Note: this short uses the Lama Temple's roof plaque plus representative Beijing and Chinese Buddhist-temple imagery for the price card; it is not a full walkthrough of the temple.

Expert Tip: book the Lama Temple a few days ahead with your passport — walk-up tickets are not sold.
